workProduct.subject: Update on your enrollment and next steps
workProduct.body:
Hello Taylor,

Thank you — we received your enrollment and the pharmacy has recorded the prescription intake. One item is still needed: the consent form requires your signature.

Please complete the consent using the same secure program channel you used for enrollment. The pharmacy must have a signed consent before it can finish its administrative checks and consider the case dispense‑ready; shipment cannot be confirmed until those steps are complete.

If you’ve already signed and submitted the consent, please let me know which channel you used so the intake team can check receipt and completeness.

Thanks,
Jordan Rivera
Willow Support
